claim: A torch decoration (type 30) draws its flame only while its state is 1 and smoke when it is off, so it can be put out by a wire. A candle or other plain decoration keeps its flame whatever its state.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/view.cpp:2930 case kDecorationTorch: state 1 draws picnum+1 and the high torch effect, otherwise smoke
use: Use type 30 for fires that a rite or switch puts out, with LampGroup for the light they give; never wire a candle to go dark.
